LESSON: WUDHU

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Devotional Acts
Topic 4.1.2: Wudhu

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Wudhu
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What nullifies wudhu?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. state the nullifiers of wudhu (ablution) to maintain a state of ritual purity
2. value the need to be in a state of purity as a condition for ibadah

• Model 2: value the need to be in a state of purity as a condition for ibadah

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

SECTION: WORK TO DO

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What nullifies wudhu?
2. Why is it important to be in a state of wudhu?
